About me

Environmental economist by training, official statistician by trade. I specialise in applying data science to modernise the production of fisheries and aquaculture statistics at FAO. My work features the automation of statistics production pipelines, the production of varied and sophisticated data visualisation products, and recurrent co-authorship of flagship FAO publications. Having lived and worked in eight different countries, I thrive in the multicultural environments of international institutions.

Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) of the UN · Rome, IT and remote
